set.body:
fmri_lm_control(noise, robust, variance, weights, projection, na_action).

compute_spec() becomes a sibling argument of fmri_lm(), NOT a member of control:
control decides what is estimated, compute decides only how the estimate is
obtained. Nesting compute would bury the most important boundary in the design one
level down.

Also: na_action is currently an undocumented formal (R/fmri_lm_config.R:73; it
appears in man/fmri_lm_control.Rd \usage with no \item). Document it here.

Keep the existing list-based path working by translating onto specs.
set.title: Rebuild fmri_lm_control() on specs; move compute out
